claim: Local automated ordinary +inventory/+party/+use/+deposit/+evolve command/model acceptance with real private PostgreSQL and production battle-Pokemon reconstruction; setup and captured session transport are separate.
not_claimed: fresh live battles for all species
scope: two existing ability items through shared fresh owned-target checks and atomic transactions
derive unique legal slots from saved exact canonical species/form and current ability name
ordinary-slot Capsule and selected SV reversible Patch policy with H returning to slot 0
guard native/regional/gender/form restrictions and special slots; never repair foreign abilities
help/status, production-command tests, source-pinned reports and lifecycle CI

rules.patch_reversal: Hidden H always returns to ordinary 0, never remembered ordinary 1; use Capsule afterward if needed
rules.name_only_model: Current and destination ability names must each identify one canonical slot. Foreign, blank or ambiguous names reject without debit; no independent slot migration is needed.
rules.native_form: Exact freshly saved species/form only; no nickname or base-species ability fallback. Reject transformed/foreign-native metadata, unknown species, battle-only and required-item/ability forms, and inconsistent fixed-gender forms.
rules.special_slots: Neither item creates or removes S abilities such as Own Tempo, Battle Bond or Power Construct
rules.no_effect: No distinct legal destination or Capsule on hidden/special slot consumes no stock
rules.atomicity: Only ability and one bag copy change; failed/partial debit and failed saves roll back SQL and caches
rules.concurrent_toggles: Every waiting command re-reads current slot/stock; two stocked intentional toggles may legally return to the starting slot while spending two copies

canonical_data_audit.evidence_kind: metadata consistency only; separate from player-flow acceptance

source_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 normalized LF text; checked against staged and committed blobs before publication.

setup_and_cleanup.fixture_setup: Fresh private loopback PostgreSQL, isolated schemas, tagged ordinary User owners, canonical slot-3 level-50 Eevee, calculated stats, gapped active moves 1/4 and actual Trainer.add_item stock. Explicit SQL setup creates saved abilities/forms while leaving old identity-map values stale.
setup_and_cleanup.transport_adapters: Capture session output, delegate production User inventory/storage, run real command parse/func, field transaction, evolution and battle-Pokemon construction. No successful item effect is mocked.
setup_and_cleanup.negative_injection: Malformed/duplicate dex profiles and transformed/native attributes are negative setup only; actual commands must reject them. Debit faults occur before/after real SQL; save faults after actual ability UPDATE. Concurrency uses independent synchronized connections.
setup_and_cleanup.cleanup: All isolated schemas removed, public tables empty, private task cluster stopped; no existing database, human character, service or migration runner used.
